01 / THE GROUP

One group.
A connected outlook.

GOT Holdings brings products, people and supply chains together.

Salt sits at the heart of our business. Through GOT Salt Products, GOT Logistics and GOT Ventures, we connect commodity supply with transport partnerships and opportunities across the industrial sector.

Our entrepreneurial approach is focused on practical value: helping customers source, move and distribute the products their businesses depend on.
